faq.q: Does this page show only condos, and only in Cloverdale?
faq.a: No — as read, the feed carries attached product across the whole Cloverdale board community: cards labelled "Cloverdale BC" and cards labelled "Clayton," and at least one card (103 16488 64th Avenue) whose own listing text describes a townhome. Buyers who want condo apartments only, or the Cloverdale sub-area only, should filter inside the feed.

faq.q: Does SnapStats publish a condo-only median for Cloverdale?
faq.a: No. SnapStats splits Cloverdale only as Detached versus "Condos & Townhomes" combined, and publishes medians at community level only — the September 2026 combined median is $740,000 ($503/sq ft, 96% sale-to-list, 32 days on market) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools serve Cloverdale and Clayton condo buildings?
faq.a: Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file in this ground include A J McLellan, George Greenaway, Martha Currie, Don Christian and Sunrise Ridge elementaries, and Lord Tweedsmuir, Clayton Heights and École Salish secondaries — but SD36 catchments are address-based and no locator result for these buildings is on record, so check the exact address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
